CustomField.description: Path appended to the read Named Credential for the archive READ (GET) operation. The archive exposes one route per object under the gateway's /retrieve base, so this is the object segment - e.g. /OrderLineItems. Leave blank to use the per-object default in ArchiveReadService, which currently knows only Order_Line_Item__c => /OrderLineItems. An object with neither a configured nor a default path is treated as having no published route, and the report falls back to the Archival Log index for it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: GET path for reading this object's archived records, e.g. /OrderLineItems. Blank = use code default.
CustomField.label: Read Path
